mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with posaconazole may increase serotonergic activity and phenelzine accumulation due to CYP3A4 inhibition by posaconazole, with potential for hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor closely for hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome symptoms, and consider alternative antifungal agent with lower CYP3A4 inhibition.
